utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Pretty good actually. I have a huge job interview tomorrow and I'm going to kill it. I've been practicing all week and I feel really prepared.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: That's a great mindset. How has the preparation been going?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Really well. Though honestly my back is killing me from sitting at a desk all week. But I just power through it. I've been dying to get this job for months.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: It's great you've wanted this opportunity for a while. What is it about this particular role that excites you?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: It's at a startup and I'd basically be running the whole marketing department. They're going to regret not hiring me sooner when they see what I can do. I want to make them pay attention to the quality of candidates they've been overlooking.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: I love that confidence. How did the mock interviews with your friend go?

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Great. He said I nailed it. I also played video games yesterday to decompress — I want to kill that final boss before the weekend. Just need to find two more hours to get there.

utterances.speaker: Therapist
utterances.text: Decompressing before a big event is smart. Let's end early today so you can rest up. Good luck tomorrow!

utterances.speaker: Patient
utterances.text: Thanks! I'll let you know how it goes. I could just die of embarrassment if I bomb it after all this prep.
